The Market Stream Manager orchestrates subscription lifecycles through reference counting, ensuring that only active markets are tracked. It enforces a maximum number of concurrent active markets, dynamically adjusting which markets are subscribed based on recency and pinning status. The system uses a state machine to manage connection health, including reconnect logic and heartbeat mechanisms. When a market's subscription count drops to zero, it's unsubscribed and its resources are released. This design supports both real-time data streaming and efficient resource management in high-volume environments.
